scenes.narration: Your car loan hides a second price tag.
A twenty thousand dollar car at seven percent interest costs far more than the sticker price.

scenes.label: extra interest over 60 months
scenes.narration: Over sixty months that is about three thousand eight hundred dollars in interest.
Three levers matter. A shorter term, a bigger down payment, and shopping the rate.
Sixty months costs thirty eight hundred. Thirty six months costs about twenty two hundred.
The longer the loan, the more interest piles up, month after month.
Check the term before you sign. Follow for more money maths.
